override.repo_standard: global-crew.md 'explicit contracts at meaningful boundaries' + global-everyone.md deep-module doctrine (a pure function's interface is its explicit injected deps, no hidden state) + module contract 'PURE module'
override.reason: join_weekend_prior has 7 params (3 essential data: composition/cells/vocabulary; 4 keyword-only config with defaults: as_of_round/nu_loss/rule/map_version). The tail-rule + nu_loss params ARE the predictive_t seam; bundling them into a parameter object would hide that seam and the pure-function's explicit-dependency contract. The standard (explicit boundary contract for a pure function) subordinates the smell.

smells.finding: Single responsibility: compose composition x cells into one prior.

rule/nu_loss are the live predictive_t seam; map_version is provenance carried into the output. No unused hooks; the linear join IS the prior (sequence/interaction forms are #670, correctly deferred).
Docstrings/comments are explanatory and honest (e.g. the Build-1 independent-cell caveat), not masking bad code.
